title: Use ReminderMessage in BootReminderReceiver.onReceive()
name: onReceive
description: Same string-building duplication fix as DailyListViewModel.logDose(): build the reminder title/text via ReminderMessage.build(...) instead of an inline duplicate of the same literal strings. No import needed -- ReminderMessage is in the same notifications package as this file.
acceptance_criteria: Boot-completed action check, goAsync(), and the try/finally with pendingResult.finish() are unchanged
Inside the for loop, nextEligible is extracted once via doseLog.nextEligibleAtEpochMillis ?: continue, then val (title, text) = ReminderMessage.build(medication.name, nextEligible)
ExactAlarmScheduler.schedule(appContext, doseLog.id, nextEligible, title, text) replaces the old call with literal strings
